found.quote: 2.1 Plagiarism is defined as the use of either published or unpublished writing, ideas or works without proper acknowledgement.
Students' assignments and data should not be submitted to third party applications without consulting the College and without obtaining the student’s consent.
found.anchor: Considerations Relating to Suspected Breaches of the Academic Integrity Policy

found.quote: These systems must undergo formal risk assessments and be subject to continuous oversight to ensure they do not infringe on individual rights or institutional obligations.

unsure.quote: Students may incur a grade penalty if prior communication has been issued to them advising that GenAI cannot to be used for a particular assessment or in a particular way within the assessment.
unsure.why: Prior communication as a condition for penalty; no tariff detail.

unsure.quote: there may be a case for further investigation for a breach of the MIC Academic Integrity Policy. In such instances, the agreed procedures for reporting suspected breaches should be followed, as outlined in the MIC Code of Student Conduct.
unsure.why: Generic reporting and investigation step; no specialist or formal-right detail.

unsure.quote: Be sure to prioritise your own academic judgement, the academic judgement of your lecturer and the scholarly works you have engaged with over a Generative AI output.
unsure.why: Prioritises scholarly works over AI, but not library search or reading sources.
